72template <bool Enabled, class Storage, template <class> class CritSec>
73struct value_bitmask_field {
74 CritSec<Storage> bits{};
75
76 [[nodiscard]] bool test(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
77 const auto bval = bits.load();
78 if (UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(i >= sizeof(Storage) * 8)) return false;
79 return (bval >> i) & 1U;
80 }
81 void set(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
82 bits = static_cast<Storage>(bits.load() | (Storage{1} << i));
83 }
84 void clear(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
85 bits = static_cast<Storage>(bits.load() & ~(Storage{1} << i));
86 }
88 void remove_at(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
89 const Storage bval = bits.load();
90 const auto above =
91 static_cast<Storage>(bval >> static_cast<unsigned>(i + 1));
92 const auto below = static_cast<Storage>(bval & ((Storage{1} << i) - 1));
93 bits = static_cast<Storage>(below | (above << i));
94 }
97 void insert_at(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
98 const Storage bval = bits.load();
99 const auto above = static_cast<Storage>(bval >> i);
100 const auto below = static_cast<Storage>(bval & ((Storage{1} << i) - 1));
101 bits =
102 static_cast<Storage>(below | (above << static_cast<unsigned>(i + 1)));
103 }
104};
105
107template <bool Enabled, class T, std::size_t N, template <class> class CritSec>
108struct value_bitmask_field<Enabled, std::array<T, N>, CritSec> {
109 std::array<CritSec<T>, N> bits{};
110
111 [[nodiscard]] bool test(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
112 const T byte_val = bits[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) / 8].load();
113 return (static_cast<unsigned>(byte_val) >>
114 (static_cast<unsigned>(i) % 8U)) &
115 1U;
116 }
117 void set(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
118 const auto idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(i) / 8;
119 bits[idx] = static_cast<T>(bits[idx].load() |
120 (T{1} << (static_cast<unsigned>(i) % 8U)));
121 }
122 void clear(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
123 const auto idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(i) / 8;
124 bits[idx] = static_cast<T>(bits[idx].load() &
125 ~(T{1} << (static_cast<unsigned>(i) % 8U)));
126 }
127};

172template <class ArtPolicy>
173struct bulk_subtree_guard {
174 using db_type = typename ArtPolicy::db_type;
175 using node_ptr = typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr;
176
177 db_type& db_;
178 node_ptr ptr{nullptr};
179 bool is_packed_value{false};
180
181 constexpr explicit bulk_subtree_guard(db_type& db
182 UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) noexcept
183 : db_{db} {}
184
185 ~bulk_subtree_guard() noexcept {
186 if (ptr != nullptr && !is_packed_value) {
187 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(ptr, db_);
188 }
189 }
190
191 void release() noexcept { ptr = nullptr; }
192
193 bulk_subtree_guard(const bulk_subtree_guard&) = delete;
194 // LCOV_EXCL_START — move ctor only called on vector reallocation
195 bulk_subtree_guard(bulk_subtree_guard&& other) noexcept
196 : db_{other.db_},
197 ptr{std::exchange(other.ptr, nullptr)},
198 is_packed_value{other.is_packed_value} {}
199 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
200 auto& operator=(const bulk_subtree_guard&) = delete;
201 auto& operator=(bulk_subtree_guard&&) = delete;
202};

268//
269// TODO(thompsonbry) Partial or no key in leaf. Once we template for the Value
270// type, we can optimize for u64 or smaller values, the leaf should be replaced
271// by the use of a variant {Value,node_ptr} entry in the inode along with a bit
272// mask to indicate for each position whether it is a leaf or a node. This
273// provides a significant optimization for secondary index use cases (tree
274// height is reduced by one, no small allocations for leaves, the key is no
275// longer explicitly stored, the key size is no longer stored, the value size is
276// no longer stored, etc.). However, we would still need to allocate a leaf for
277// the case where Value is a std::span. But this becomes a simple immutable
278// data structure which exists solely to wrap the Value.
279template <class Key, class Header>
280class [[nodiscard]] basic_leaf final : public Header {
281 public:
284 using key_size_type = unodb::key_size_type;
285
288 using value_size_type = unodb::value_size_type;
289
291 static constexpr std::size_t max_key_size =
292 std::numeric_limits<key_size_type>::max();
293
295 static constexpr std::size_t max_value_size =
296 std::numeric_limits<value_size_type>::max();
297
299 using art_key_type = basic_art_key<Key>;
300
301 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26485)
302
303 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26481)
308 constexpr basic_leaf(art_key_type k, value_view v) noexcept
309 : key_size{static_cast<key_size_type>(k.size())},
310 value_size{static_cast<value_size_type>(v.size())} {
311 // Note: Runtime checks are handled upstream of this by
312 // make_db_leaf_ptr().
313 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(k.size() <= max_key_size);
314 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(v.size() <= max_value_size);
315
316 const auto tmp{k.get_key_view()};
317 std::memcpy(data, tmp.data(), key_size); // store encoded key
318 if (!v.empty()) std::memcpy(data + key_size, v.data(), value_size);
319 }
320 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()

327 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr auto get_key() const noexcept {

334 // TODO(thompsonbry) memory align leaf::data[0] to 8 bytes?

337 // Note: The encoded key is stored in the leaf. Since the
338 // art_key constructor encodes the key, we need to decode the
339 // key before calling the constructor.
340 return art_key_type{bswap(u)};
341 }
342 }

586template <typename Key, typename Value, template <typename, typename> class Db>
587[[nodiscard]] auto make_db_leaf_ptr(basic_art_key<Key> k, Value v,
588 Db<Key, Value>& db
589 UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) {
590 using db_type = Db<Key, Value>;
591 using header_type = typename db_type::header_type;
592 using leaf_type = basic_leaf<leaf_key_type<Key, Value>, header_type>;
593
594 if constexpr (!can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value> &&
595 std::is_same_v<Key, key_view>) {
596 if (UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(k.size() > leaf_type::max_key_size)) {
597 throw std::length_error("Key length must fit in std::uint32_t");
598 }
599 }
600
601 // Serialize value to bytes for leaf storage.
602 value_view leaf_val_bytes;
603 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26496)
604 [[maybe_unused]] std::byte val_buf[sizeof(Value)]{};
605 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
606 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<Value, value_view>) {
607 leaf_val_bytes = v;
608 } else {
609 static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<Value>);
610 std::memcpy(val_buf, &v, sizeof(v));
611 leaf_val_bytes = value_view{val_buf, sizeof(v)};
612 }
613
614 if (UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(leaf_val_bytes.size_bytes() >
615 leaf_type::max_value_size)) {
616 throw std::length_error("Value length must fit in std::uint32_t");
617 }
618
619 std::size_t size;
620 if constexpr (can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value>) {
621 size = leaf_type::compute_size(
622 static_cast<typename leaf_type::value_size_type>(
623 leaf_val_bytes.size_bytes()));
624 } else {
625 size = leaf_type::compute_size(
626 static_cast<typename leaf_type::key_size_type>(k.size()),
627 static_cast<typename leaf_type::value_size_type>(
628 leaf_val_bytes.size_bytes()));
629 }
630
631 auto* const leaf_mem = static_cast<std::byte*>(db.get_allocator().alloc(
632 size, alignment_for_new<leaf_type>(), db.get_allocator().ctx));
633
634#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
635 db.increment_leaf_count(size);
636#endif // UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
637
638 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26402)
639 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26400)
640 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26496)
641 auto* const leaf = [&]() noexcept {
642 if constexpr (can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value>) {
643 return new (leaf_mem) leaf_type{leaf_val_bytes};
644 } else {
645 return new (leaf_mem) leaf_type{k, leaf_val_bytes};
646 }
647 }();
648 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
649 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
650 return basic_db_leaf_unique_ptr<Key, Value, header_type, Db>{
651 leaf, basic_db_leaf_deleter<db_type>{db}};
652 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
653}

735 template <typename, typename, class> class INodeReclamator,
736 template <class> class LeafReclamator>
737struct basic_art_policy final {

745 using value_type = Value;

748 using art_key_type = basic_art_key<Key>;

751 using node_ptr = NodePtr;

786 std::is_trivially_copyable_v<Value> &&
787 (sizeof(Value) <= sizeof(std::uint64_t));
788 static_assert(sizeof(std::uintptr_t) <= sizeof(std::uint64_t),
789 "node_ptr must fit in a uint64_t slot");
790
793 static constexpr bool full_key_in_inode_path = std::is_same_v<Key, key_view>;
794
796 static constexpr bool can_eliminate_key_in_leaf =
797 can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value>;
798
801 static constexpr bool can_eliminate_leaf =
802 full_key_in_inode_path && value_in_slot;

806 [[nodiscard]] static node_ptr pack_value(Value v) noexcept {
807 static_assert(can_eliminate_leaf);
808 std::uint64_t raw{};
809 static_assert(sizeof(v) <= sizeof(raw));
810 // cppcheck-suppress bufferAccessOutOfBounds
811 std::memcpy(&raw, &v, sizeof(v));
812 node_ptr result{nullptr};
813 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26474)
814 // cppcheck-suppress memsetClass
815 std::memcpy(static_cast<void*>(&result), &raw, sizeof(raw));
816 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
817 return result;
818 }

821 [[nodiscard]] static Value unpack_value(node_ptr n) noexcept {
822 static_assert(can_eliminate_leaf);

824 Value v{};
825 // cppcheck-suppress memsetClass
826 std::memcpy(&v, &raw, sizeof(v));

832 std::conditional_t<can_eliminate_leaf, no_leaf_tag,

1026 struct delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit final {
1028 constexpr explicit delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit(
1029 NodePtr node_ptr_ UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND,
1030 db_type& db_ UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) noexcept
1031 : node_ptr{node_ptr_}, db{db_} {}
1032
1034 // MSVC C26815 false positive: the destructor creates unique_ptrs whose
1035 // deleters hold references to db. These are immediately destroyed while db
1036 // (a member reference) is still valid - the constructor's LIFETIMEBOUND
1037 // guarantees the referent outlives this object.
1038 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
1039 ~delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit() noexcept {
1040 switch (node_ptr.type()) {
1041 case node_type::LEAF: {
1042 if constexpr (!can_eliminate_leaf) {
1043 const auto r{
1044 make_db_leaf_ptr(node_ptr.template ptr<leaf_type*>(), db)};
1045 }
1046 return;
1047 }
1048 case node_type::I4: {
1049 // cppcheck-suppress throwInNoexceptFunction
1050 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1051 node_ptr.template ptr<inode4_type*>(), db)};
1052 return;
1053 }
1054 case node_type::I16: {
1055 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1056 node_ptr.template ptr<inode16_type*>(), db)};
1057 return;
1058 }
1059 case node_type::I48: {
1060 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1061 node_ptr.template ptr<inode48_type*>(), db)};
1062 return;
1063 }
1064 case node_type::I256: {
1065 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1066 node_ptr.template ptr<inode256_type*>(), db)};
1067 return;
1068 }
1069 }
1070 UNODB_DETAIL_CANNOT_HAPPEN(); // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
1071 }
1072 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
1073
1074
1075 delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit(const delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&) =
1076 delete;
1077
1079 delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit(delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&&) =
1080 delete;
1081
1083 auto& operator=(const delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&) = delete;
1084
1086 auto& operator=(delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&&) = delete;
1087
1088 private:
1090 const NodePtr node_ptr;
1091
1093 db_type& db;
1094 };

1102 struct subtree_guard final {
1103 constexpr subtree_guard(NodePtr node,
1104 db_type& db UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) noexcept
1105 : node_{node}, db_{db} {}
1106
1107 ~subtree_guard() noexcept {
1108 if (node_ != nullptr) delete_subtree(node_, db_);
1109 }
1110
1111 void release() noexcept { node_ = nullptr; }
1112
1113 subtree_guard(const subtree_guard&) = delete;
1114 subtree_guard(subtree_guard&&) = delete;
1115 auto& operator=(const subtree_guard&) = delete;
1116 auto& operator=(subtree_guard&&) = delete;
1117
1118 private:
1119 NodePtr node_;
1120 db_type& db_;
1121 };

1130 static void delete_subtree(NodePtr node, db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
1131 delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit delete_on_scope_exit{node, db_instance};
1132
1133 switch (node.type()) {
1134 case node_type::LEAF:
1135 return;
1136 case node_type::I4: {
1137 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode4_type*>()};
1138 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1139 return;
1140 }
1141 case node_type::I16: {
1142 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode16_type*>()};
1143 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1144 return;
1145 }
1146 case node_type::I48: {
1147 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode48_type*>()};
1148 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1149 return;
1150 }
1151 case node_type::I256: {
1152 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode256_type*>()};
1153 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1154 return;
1155 }
1156 }
1157 }

1164 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE static void dump_node(
1165 std::ostream& os, const NodePtr& node, bool recursive = true) {
1166 os << "node at: " << node.template ptr<void*>() << ", tagged ptr = 0x"
1167 << std::hex << node.raw_val() << std::dec;
1168 if (node == nullptr) {
1169 os << '\n';
1170 return;
1171 }
1172 os << ", type = ";
1173 switch (node.type()) {
1174 case node_type::LEAF:
1175 os << "LEAF";
1176 if constexpr (!can_eliminate_leaf) {
1177 node.template ptr<leaf_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1178 }
1179 break;
1180 case node_type::I4:
1181 os << "I4";
1182 node.template ptr<inode4_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1183 break;
1184 case node_type::I16:
1185 os << "I16";
1186 node.template ptr<inode16_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1187 break;
1188 case node_type::I48:
1189 os << "I48";
1190 node.template ptr<inode48_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1191 break;
1192 case node_type::I256:
1193 os << "I256";
1194 node.template ptr<inode256_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1195 break;
1196 }
1197 }

1216union [[nodiscard]] key_prefix_snapshot {
1217 // TODO(thompsonbry) Can this be replaced by [using
1218 // key_prefix_snapshot = key_prefix<std::uint64_t,
1219 // in_fake_critical_section>]? We need the snapshot to be

1224 using key_prefix_data = std::array<std::byte, key_prefix_capacity>;
1225
1227 struct [[nodiscard]] inode_fields {
1229 key_prefix_data key_prefix;
1231 key_prefix_size key_prefix_length{};
1232 };
1233
1235 inode_fields f;
1237 std::uint64_t u64;
1238
1239 public:
1243 constexpr explicit key_prefix_snapshot(std::uint64_t v) noexcept : u64(v) {}
1244
1248 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_view get_key_view() const noexcept {
1249 return key_view(f.key_prefix.data(), f.key_prefix_length);
1250 }
1251
1255 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_prefix_size length() const noexcept {

1257 }
1258
1266 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto get_shared_length(
1267 std::uint64_t shifted_key_u64) const noexcept {

1275 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto operator[](std::size_t i) const noexcept {
1276 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < length());

1279
1286 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr unsigned shared_len(
1287 std::uint64_t k1, std::uint64_t k2, unsigned clamp_byte_pos) noexcept {
1288 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(clamp_byte_pos < 8);
1289
1290 const auto diff = k1 ^ k2;
1291 const auto clamped = diff | (1ULL << (clamp_byte_pos * 8U));
1292 return static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(clamped) >> 3U);
1293 }

1304template <typename ArtKey, template <class> class CriticalSectionPolicy>
1305union [[nodiscard]] key_prefix {
1306 private:
1308 template <typename T>
1309 using critical_section_policy = CriticalSectionPolicy<T>;
1310
1312 using key_prefix_data =
1313 std::array<critical_section_policy<std::byte>, key_prefix_capacity>;
1314
1316 struct [[nodiscard]] inode_fields {
1318 key_prefix_data key_prefix;
1320 critical_section_policy<key_prefix_size> key_prefix_length;
1321 };
1322
1324 inode_fields f;
1326 critical_section_policy<std::uint64_t> u64;
1327
1328 public:
1334 key_prefix(key_view k1, ArtKey shifted_k2, tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept
1335 : u64{make_u64(k1, shifted_k2, depth)} {}
1336
1338 key_prefix(detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, key_view k1,
1339 tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept
1340 : u64{make_u64_explicit(prefix_len, k1, depth)} {}
1341
1346 key_prefix(unsigned key_prefix_len,
1347 const key_prefix& source_key_prefix) noexcept
1348 : u64{(source_key_prefix.u64 & key_bytes_mask) |
1349 length_to_word(key_prefix_len)} {
1350 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(key_prefix_len <= key_prefix_capacity);
1351 }
1352
1354 key_prefix(const key_prefix& other) noexcept : u64{other.u64.load()} {}
1355
1357 ~key_prefix() noexcept = default;
1358
1363 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto get_shared_length(
1364 ArtKey shifted_key) const noexcept {
1365 return get_shared_length(shifted_key.get_u64());
1366 }
1367
1372 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto get_shared_length(
1373 std::uint64_t shifted_key_u64) const noexcept {
1374 return shared_len(shifted_key_u64, u64, length());
1375 }
1376
1383 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_prefix_snapshot get_snapshot() const noexcept {
1384 return key_prefix_snapshot(u64);
1385 }
1386
1390 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_prefix_size length() const noexcept {
1391 const auto result = f.key_prefix_length.load();
1392 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(result <= key_prefix_capacity);
1393 return result;
1394 }
1395
1399 constexpr void cut(key_prefix_size cut_len) noexcept {
1400 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(cut_len > 0);
1401 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(cut_len <= length());
1402
1403 u64 = ((u64 >> (cut_len * 8)) & key_bytes_mask) |
1404 length_to_word(static_cast<key_prefix_size>(length() - cut_len));
1405
1406 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(f.key_prefix_length.load() <= key_prefix_capacity);
1407 }
1408
1415 constexpr void prepend(const key_prefix& prefix1,
1416 std::byte prefix2) noexcept {
1417 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(length() + prefix1.length() < key_prefix_capacity);
1418
1419 const auto prefix1_bit_length = prefix1.length() * 8U;
1420 const auto prefix1_mask = (1ULL << prefix1_bit_length) - 1;
1421 const auto prefix3_bit_length = length() * 8U;
1422 const auto prefix3_mask = (1ULL << prefix3_bit_length) - 1;
1423 const auto prefix3 = u64 & prefix3_mask;
1424 const auto shifted_prefix3 = prefix3 << (prefix1_bit_length + 8U);
1425 const auto shifted_prefix2 = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(prefix2)
1426 << prefix1_bit_length;
1427 const auto masked_prefix1 = prefix1.u64 & prefix1_mask;
1428
1429 u64 = shifted_prefix3 | shifted_prefix2 | masked_prefix1 |
1430 length_to_word(length() + prefix1.length() + 1U);
1431
1432 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(f.key_prefix_length.load() <= key_prefix_capacity);
1433 }
1434
1439 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto operator[](std::size_t i) const noexcept {
1440 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < length());
1441 return f.key_prefix[i].load();
1442 }
1443
1447 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE void dump(std::ostream& os) const {
1448 const auto len = length();
1449 os << ", prefix(" << len << ")";
1450 if (len > 0) {
1451 os << ": 0x";
1452 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) dump_byte(os, f.key_prefix[i]);
1453 }
1454 }
1455
1457 key_prefix(key_prefix&&) = delete;
1458
1460 key_prefix& operator=(const key_prefix&) = delete;
1461
1463 key_prefix& operator=(key_prefix&&) = delete;
1464
1465 private:
1467 static constexpr auto key_bytes_mask = 0x00FF'FFFF'FFFF'FFFFULL;
1468
1470 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr std::uint64_t length_to_word(
1471 unsigned length) {
1472 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(length <= key_prefix_capacity);
1473 return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(length) << 56U;
1474 }
1475
1477 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr unsigned shared_len(
1478 std::uint64_t k1, std::uint64_t k2, unsigned clamp_byte_pos) noexcept {
1479 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(clamp_byte_pos < 8);
1480
1481 const auto diff = k1 ^ k2;
1482 const auto clamped = diff | (1ULL << (clamp_byte_pos * 8U));
1483 return static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(clamped) >> 3U);
1484 }
1485
1493 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr std::uint64_t make_u64(
1494 key_view k1, ArtKey shifted_k2, tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept {
1495 k1 = k1.subspan(depth); // shift_right(depth)
1496
1497 const auto k1_u64 = get_u64(k1) & key_bytes_mask;
1498
1499 return k1_u64 | length_to_word(shared_len(k1_u64, shifted_k2.get_u64(),
1500 key_prefix_capacity));
1501 }
1502
1504 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr std::uint64_t make_u64_explicit(
1505 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, key_view k1,
1506 tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept {
1507 k1 = k1.subspan(depth);
1508 const auto k1_u64 = get_u64(k1) & key_bytes_mask;
1509 return k1_u64 | length_to_word(prefix_len);
1510 }
1511}; // class key_prefix

2432 [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool can_collapse(
2433 std::uint8_t child_to_delete) const noexcept {
2434 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->is_min_size());
2435 const std::uint8_t child_to_leave = (child_to_delete == 0) ? 1U : 0U;
2436 const auto child_ptr = children[child_to_leave].load();
2437 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
2438 if (is_value_in_slot(child_to_leave)) return false;
2439 }
2440 if (child_ptr.type() == node_type::LEAF) {
2441 // For keyless leaves, collapsing would lose key bytes encoded
2442 // in this inode's prefix+dispatch. Keep the chain intact.
2443 return !ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_key_in_leaf;
2444 }
2445 const auto* const child_inode{child_ptr.template ptr<inode_type*>()};
2446 return this->get_key_prefix().length() +
2447 child_inode->get_key_prefix().length() <
2448 detail::key_prefix_capacity;
2449 }

2484 template <typename LeafPtr>
2485 constexpr void init(node_ptr source_node, unsigned shared_prefix_len,
2486 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth, LeafPtr&& child1,
2487 std::byte child1_key_byte) {
2488 auto* const source_inode{source_node.template ptr<inode_type*>()};
2489 auto& source_key_prefix = source_inode->get_key_prefix();
2490 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(shared_prefix_len < source_key_prefix.length());
2491
2492 const auto source_node_key_byte = source_key_prefix[shared_prefix_len];
2493 source_key_prefix.cut(static_cast<key_prefix_size>(shared_prefix_len) + 1U);
2494 add_two_to_empty(source_node_key_byte, source_node, child1_key_byte,
2495 std::move(child1));
2496 }

2500 template <typename LeafPtr>
2501 constexpr void init(node_ptr source_node, unsigned shared_prefix_len,
2502 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
2503 LeafPtr&& child1) {
2504 const auto diff_key_byte_i = depth + shared_prefix_len;
2505 init(source_node, shared_prefix_len, depth, std::forward<LeafPtr>(child1),
2506 static_cast<std::byte>(this->leaf_key_byte_at(
2507 child1.get(), tree_depth_type{diff_key_byte_i})));
2508 }
2509
2515 // MSVC C26815 false positive: reclaim objects intentionally destroyed at
2516 // scope exit while db_instance (passed by caller) remains valid.
2517 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
2518 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26460)
2519 constexpr void init(db_type& db_instance, inode16_type& source_node,
2520 std::uint8_t child_to_delete) {
2521 const auto reclaim_source_node{
2522 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode16_type>(
2523 &source_node, db_instance)};
2524 auto source_keys_itr = source_node.keys.byte_array.cbegin();
2525 auto keys_itr = keys.byte_array.begin();
2526 auto source_children_itr = source_node.children.cbegin();
2527 auto children_itr = children.begin();
2528
2529 while (source_keys_itr !=
2530 source_node.keys.byte_array.cbegin() + child_to_delete) {
2531 *keys_itr++ = *source_keys_itr++;
2532 *children_itr++ = *source_children_itr++;
2533 }
2534
2535 [[maybe_unused]] const auto r{
2536 ArtPolicy::reclaim_if_leaf(source_children_itr->load(), db_instance)};
2537
2538 ++source_keys_itr;
2539 ++source_children_itr;
2540
2541 while (source_keys_itr !=
2542 source_node.keys.byte_array.cbegin() + inode16_type::min_size) {
2543 *keys_itr++ = *source_keys_itr++;
2544 *children_itr++ = *source_children_itr++;
2545 }

2547 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == basic_inode_4::capacity);
2548 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
2549 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
2550 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + basic_inode_4::capacity));
2551
2552 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
2553 std::uint8_t dst = 0;
2554 for (std::uint8_t src = 0; src < inode16_type::min_size; ++src) {
2555 if (src == child_to_delete) continue;
2556 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(src)) set_value_bit(dst);
2557 ++dst;

2559 }

2607 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(db_leaf_unique_ptr&& child,
2608 // cppcheck-suppress passedByValue
2609 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
2610 std::byte key_byte,
2611 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
2612 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ == this->children_count);
2613 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
2614 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
2615 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
2616
2617 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte);
2618#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2619 const auto mask = (1U << children_count_) - 1;
2620 const auto insert_pos_index = get_insert_pos(kb, mask);
2621#else
2622 // This is also currently the best ARM implementation.
2623 const auto first_lt = ((keys.integer & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
2624 const auto second_lt = (((keys.integer >> 8U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
2625 const auto third_lt = ((keys.integer >> 16U) & 0xFFU) < kb ? 1 : 0;
2626 const auto insert_pos_index =
2627 static_cast<unsigned>(first_lt + second_lt + third_lt);
2628#endif
2629
2630 for (typename decltype(keys.byte_array)::size_type i = children_count_;
2631 i > insert_pos_index; --i) {
2632 keys.byte_array[i] = keys.byte_array[i - 1];
2633 children[i] = children[i - 1];
2634 }
2635 keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] = key_byte;
2636 children[insert_pos_index] = node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF};
2637
2638 // Shift value bitmask to match shifted children array.
2639 // The new entry is a leaf (not a packed value), so no bit is set for it.
2640 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
2641 bitmask_base::insert_at(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
2642 }
2643
2644 ++children_count_;
2645 this->children_count = children_count_;
2646
2647 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
2648 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
2649 }

2652 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(node_ptr packed_value,
2653 // cppcheck-suppress passedByValue
2654 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
2655 std::byte key_byte,
2656 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
2657 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ == this->children_count);
2658 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
2659
2660 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte);
2661#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2662 const auto mask = (1U << children_count_) - 1;
2663 const auto insert_pos_index = get_insert_pos(kb, mask);
2664#else
2665 const auto first_lt = ((keys.integer & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
2666 const auto second_lt = (((keys.integer >> 8U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
2667 const auto third_lt = ((keys.integer >> 16U) & 0xFFU) < kb ? 1 : 0;
2668 const auto insert_pos_index =
2669 static_cast<unsigned>(first_lt + second_lt + third_lt);
2670#endif
2671
2672 for (typename decltype(keys.byte_array)::size_type i = children_count_;
2673 i > insert_pos_index; --i) {

2785 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] find_result find_child(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
2786#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2787 const auto replicated_search_key =
2788 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(key_byte));
2789 const auto keys_in_sse_reg =
2790 _mm_cvtsi32_si128(static_cast<std::int32_t>(keys.integer.load()));
2791 const auto matching_key_positions =
2792 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(replicated_search_key, keys_in_sse_reg);
2793 const auto mask = (1U << this->children_count.load()) - 1;
2794 const auto bit_field =
2795 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(matching_key_positions)) & mask;
2796 if (bit_field != 0) {
2797 const auto i = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::countr_zero(bit_field));
2798 return std::make_pair(
2799 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
2800 }
2801 return parent_class::child_not_found;
2802#elif defined(__aarch64__)
2803 const auto replicated_search_key =
2804 vdupq_n_u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
2805 const auto keys_in_neon_reg = vreinterpretq_u8_u32(
2806 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
2807 vsetq_lane_u32(keys.integer.load(), vdupq_n_u32(0), 0));
2808 const auto mask = (1ULL << (this->children_count.load() << 3U)) - 1;
2809 const auto matching_key_positions =
2810 vceqq_u8(replicated_search_key, keys_in_neon_reg);
2811 const auto u64_pos_in_vec =
2812 vget_low_u64(vreinterpretq_u64_u8(matching_key_positions));
2813 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
2814 const auto pos_in_scalar = vget_lane_u64(u64_pos_in_vec, 0);
2815 const auto masked_pos = pos_in_scalar & mask;
2816
2817 if (masked_pos == 0) return parent_class::child_not_found;
2818
2819 const auto i = static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(masked_pos) >> 3U);
2820 return std::make_pair(
2821 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
2822#else // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2823 // Bit twiddling:
2824 // contains_byte: std::countr_zero: for key index:
2825 // 0x80000000 0x1F 3
2826 // 0x800000 0x17 2
2827 // 0x8000 0x0F 1
2828 // 0x80 0x07 0
2829 // 0x0 UB (check!) not found
2830 const auto match = contains_byte(keys.integer, key_byte);
2831 if (match == 0) return parent_class::child_not_found;
2832
2833 const auto result =
2834 static_cast<typename decltype(keys.byte_array)::size_type>(
2835 std::countr_zero(match) >> 3U);
2836
2837 // The condition could be replaced with masking, but this seems to result
2838 // in a benchmark regression
2839 if (result >= this->children_count.load())
2840 return parent_class::child_not_found;
2841
2842 return std::make_pair(
2843 result,
2844 static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[result]));
2845#endif // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2846 }

2861 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result
2862 begin() noexcept {
2863 const auto key = keys.byte_array[0].load();
2864 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, static_cast<uint8_t>(0),
2865 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};

2871 // TODO(laurynas) The iter_result-returning sequences follow the
2872 // same pattern once child_index is known. Look into extracting a
2873 // small helper method. This might apply to other inode types
2874 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result
2875 last() noexcept {
2876 const auto child_index{
2877 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(this->children_count.load() - 1)};
2878 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
2879 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, child_index,
2880 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};

2882
2888 // TODO(laurynas) explore 1) branchless 2) SIMD implementations for
2889 // begin(), last(), next(), prior(), get_key_byte(), and
2890 // lte_key_byte(). next() and begin() will be the most frequently
2891 // invoked methods (assuming forward traversal), so that would be
2892 // the place to start. The GTE and LTE methods are only used by
2893 // seek() so they are relatively rarely invoked. Look at each of the
2894 // inode types when doing this.
2895 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
2896 next(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
2897 const auto nchildren{this->children_count.load()};
2898 const auto next_index{static_cast<uint8_t>(child_index + 1)};
2899 if (next_index >= nchildren) return parent_class::end_result;
2900 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
2901 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, next_index,
2902 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
2903 }
2904
2910 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
2911 prior(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
2912 if (child_index == 0) return parent_class::end_result;
2913 const auto next_index{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_index - 1)};
2914 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
2915 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, next_index,
2916 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
2917 }
2918
2924 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
2925 gte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
2926 const auto nchildren{this->children_count.load()};
2927 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < nchildren; ++i) {
2928 const auto key = keys.byte_array[i].load();
2929 if (key >= key_byte) {
2930 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, i,
2931 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
2932 }
2933 }
2934 // This should only occur if there is no entry in the keys[] which
2935 // is greater-than the given [key_byte].
2936 return parent_class::end_result;
2937 }
2938
2944 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
2945 lte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
2946 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
2947 for (std::int64_t i = children_count_ - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
2948 const auto child_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
2949 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
2950 if (key <= key_byte) {
2951 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, child_index,
2952 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
2953 }
2954 }
2955 // The first key in the node is GT the given key_byte.
2956 return parent_class::end_result;
2957 }

3006 constexpr void add_two_to_empty(std::byte key1, node_ptr child1,
3007 std::byte key2,
3008 db_leaf_unique_ptr child2) noexcept {
3009 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(key1 != key2);
3010 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == 2);
3011
3012 const std::uint8_t key1_i = key1 < key2 ? 0U : 1U;
3013 const std::uint8_t key2_i = 1U - key1_i;
3014 keys.byte_array[key1_i] = key1;
3015 children[key1_i] = child1;
3016 keys.byte_array[key2_i] = key2;
3017 children[key2_i] = node_ptr{child2.release(), node_type::LEAF};
3018#ifndef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3019 keys.byte_array[2] = unused_key_byte;
3020 keys.byte_array[3] = unused_key_byte;
3021#endif
3022
3023 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3024 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3025 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + this->children_count));
3026 }
3027
3029 constexpr void add_two_to_empty(std::byte key1, node_ptr child1,
3030 std::byte key2, node_ptr child2) noexcept {
3031 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(key1 != key2);
3032 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == 2);
3033
3034 const std::uint8_t key1_i = key1 < key2 ? 0U : 1U;
3035 const std::uint8_t key2_i = 1U - key1_i;
3036 keys.byte_array[key1_i] = key1;
3037 children[key1_i] = child1;
3038 keys.byte_array[key2_i] = key2;
3039 children[key2_i] = child2;
3040 // child2 is always a packed value in the value-in-slot path.
3041 // child1 may be an inode (existing subtree) or a packed value.
3042 set_value_bit(key2_i);
3043#ifndef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3044 keys.byte_array[2] = unused_key_byte;
3045 keys.byte_array[3] = unused_key_byte;
3046#endif
3047
3048 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3049 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3050 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + this->children_count));
3051 }

3054 union key_union {
3056 std::array<critical_section_policy<std::byte>, basic_inode_4::capacity>
3057 byte_array;
3059 critical_section_policy<std::uint32_t> integer;
3060
3062 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26495)
3063 constexpr key_union() noexcept {}

3069 [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool is_value_in_slot(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
3070 return bitmask_base::test(i);
3071 }
3073 constexpr void set_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3074 bitmask_base::set(i);
3075 }
3077 constexpr void clear_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3078 bitmask_base::clear(i);

3095#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3102 [[nodiscard]] auto get_insert_pos(std::uint8_t insert_key_byte,
3103 unsigned node_key_mask) const noexcept {
3104 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(node_key_mask ==
3105 (1U << this->children_count.load()) - 1);
3106
3107 const auto replicated_insert_key_byte =
3108 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(insert_key_byte));
3109 const auto node_keys_in_sse_reg =
3110 _mm_cvtsi32_si128(static_cast<std::int32_t>(keys.integer.load()));
3111 // Since the existing and insert key values cannot be equal, it's OK to use
3112 // "<=" comparison as "<".
3113 const auto le_node_key_positions =
3114 _mm_cmple_epu8(node_keys_in_sse_reg, replicated_insert_key_byte);
3115 const auto bit_field =
3116 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(le_node_key_positions)) &
3117 node_key_mask;
3118 return static_cast<unsigned>(std::popcount(bit_field));
3119 }
3120#else
3122 static constexpr std::byte unused_key_byte{0xFF};
3123#endif

3141 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
3142 db_type& db_instance, detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len,
3143 unodb::key_view prefix_key, tree_depth_type depth,
3144 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
3145 std::uint8_t value_mask = 0) {
3146 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
3147 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 2 && n <= 4);
3148 auto result =
3149 inode4_type::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
3150 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
3151 auto* node = result.get();
3152 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
3153 node->keys.byte_array[i] = children_span[i].key_byte;
3154 node->children[i] = children_span[i].child;
3155 }
3156#ifndef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3157 for (unsigned i = n; i < 4; ++i) node->keys.byte_array[i] = unused_key_byte;
3158#endif
3159 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3160 node->bitmask_base::bits = value_mask;
3161 }
3162 return result;
3163 }
3164 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_CLANG_21_WARNINGS()
3165}; // class basic_inode_4

3181class basic_inode_16

3265 constexpr void init(db_type& db_instance, inode4_type& source_node,
3266 db_leaf_unique_ptr child,
3267 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3268 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3269 // This overload is only for trees with actual leaves. When
3270 // can_eliminate_leaf is true, init_grow unconditionally sets the
3271 // value bit — which is correct because only the packed-value
3272 // overload below can be called in that mode.
3273 static_assert(!ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf,
3274 "leaf init must not be called when leaves are eliminated");
3275 init_grow(db_instance, source_node,
3276 node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF}, key_byte);
3277 }
3278
3280 constexpr void init(db_type& db_instance, inode4_type& source_node,
3281 node_ptr packed_value,
3282 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3283 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3284 init_grow(db_instance, source_node, packed_value, key_byte);
3285 }
3286
3288 constexpr void init_grow(db_type& db_instance, inode4_type& source_node,
3289 node_ptr child_val, std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3290 const auto reclaim_source_node{
3291 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode4_type>(
3292 &source_node, db_instance)};
3293 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte);
3294
3295#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3296 const auto insert_pos_index = source_node.get_insert_pos(kb, 0xFU);
3297#else
3298 const auto keys_integer = source_node.keys.integer.load();
3299 const auto first_lt = ((keys_integer & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3300 const auto second_lt = (((keys_integer >> 8U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3301 const auto third_lt = (((keys_integer >> 16U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3302 const auto fourth_lt = (((keys_integer >> 24U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3303 const auto insert_pos_index =
3304 static_cast<unsigned>(first_lt + second_lt + third_lt + fourth_lt);
3305#endif
3306
3307 unsigned i = 0;
3308 for (; i < insert_pos_index; ++i) {
3309 keys.byte_array[i] = source_node.keys.byte_array[i];
3310 children[i] = source_node.children[i];
3311 }
3312
3313 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(i < parent_class::capacity);
3314
3315 keys.byte_array[i] = key_byte;
3316 children[i] = child_val;
3317 ++i;
3318
3319 for (; i <= inode4_type::capacity; ++i) {
3320 keys.byte_array[i] = source_node.keys.byte_array[i - 1];
3321 children[i] = source_node.children[i - 1];
3322 }
3323
3324 // Copy value bitmask from source, inserting the new child's bit.
3325 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3326 for (unsigned j = 0; j < insert_pos_index; ++j) {
3327 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j)))
3328 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j));
3329 }
3330 // The new child at insert_pos_index is a packed value
3331 // (this overload is only called for value-in-slot).
3332 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3333 for (unsigned j = insert_pos_index; j < inode4_type::capacity; ++j) {
3334 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j)))
3335 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j + 1));
3336 }
3337 }
3338 }
3339
3345 constexpr void init(db_type& db_instance, inode48_type& source_node,
3346 std::uint8_t child_to_delete) noexcept {
3347 const auto reclaim_source_node{
3348 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode48_type>(
3349 &source_node, db_instance)};
3350 source_node.remove_child_pointer(child_to_delete, db_instance);
3351 source_node.child_indexes[child_to_delete] = inode48_type::empty_child;
3352
3353 // TODO(laurynas): consider AVX2 gather?
3354 unsigned next_child = 0;
3355 unsigned i = 0;
3356 while (true) {
3357 const auto source_child_i = source_node.child_indexes[i].load();
3358 if (source_child_i != inode48_type::empty_child) {
3359 keys.byte_array[next_child] = static_cast<std::byte>(i);
3360 const auto source_child_ptr =
3361 source_node.children.pointer_array[source_child_i].load();
3362 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(source_child_ptr != nullptr ||
3363 source_node.is_value_in_slot_by_ci(source_child_i));
3364 children[next_child] = source_child_ptr;
3365 ++next_child;
3366 if (next_child == basic_inode_16::capacity) break;
3367 }
3368 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < 255);
3369 ++i;
3370 }
3371
3372 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == basic_inode_16::capacity);
3373 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3374 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3375 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + basic_inode_16::capacity));
3376
3377 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3378 // Copy bitmask from I48. I48 uses slot indices; we mapped them
3379 // to sequential positions in the loop above. Re-scan to set bits.
3380 next_child = 0;
3381 for (unsigned j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
3382 const auto sci = source_node.child_indexes[j].load();
3383 if (sci != inode48_type::empty_child) {
3384 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot_by_ci(sci))
3385 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(next_child));
3386 ++next_child;
3387 if (next_child == basic_inode_16::capacity) break;
3388 }
3389 }
3390 }
3391 }

3401 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(db_leaf_unique_ptr&& child,
3402 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3403 std::byte key_byte,
3404 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
3405 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ == this->children_count);
3406 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
3407 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3408 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3409
3410 const auto insert_pos_index =
3411 get_sorted_key_array_insert_position(key_byte);
3412
3413 if (insert_pos_index != children_count_) {
3414 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(insert_pos_index < children_count_);
3415 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] != key_byte);
3416
3417 std::copy_backward(keys.byte_array.cbegin() + insert_pos_index,
3418 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_,
3419 keys.byte_array.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3420 std::copy_backward(children.begin() + insert_pos_index,
3421 children.begin() + children_count_,
3422 children.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3423 }
3424
3425 keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] = key_byte;
3426 children[insert_pos_index] = node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF};
3427 // Shift value bitmask to match shifted children array.
3428 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3429 bitmask_base::insert_at(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3430 }
3431 ++children_count_;
3432 this->children_count = children_count_;
3433
3434 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3435 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3436 }
3437
3439 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(node_ptr packed_value,
3440 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3441 std::byte key_byte,
3442 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
3443 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ == this->children_count);
3444 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
3445 const auto insert_pos_index =
3446 get_sorted_key_array_insert_position(key_byte);
3447 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(insert_pos_index < parent_class::capacity);
3448 if (insert_pos_index != children_count_) {
3449 std::copy_backward(keys.byte_array.cbegin() + insert_pos_index,
3450 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_,
3451 keys.byte_array.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3452 std::copy_backward(children.begin() + insert_pos_index,
3453 children.begin() + children_count_,
3454 children.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3455 }
3456 keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] = key_byte;
3457 children[insert_pos_index] = packed_value;
3458 // Shift existing value bits to match shifted children, then set new bit.
3459 bitmask_base::insert_at(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3460 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3461 ++children_count_;
3462 this->children_count = children_count_;
3463 }

3469 // MSVC C26815 false positive: reclaim object intentionally destroyed at
3470 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26460)
3471 // scope exit while db_instance (passed by caller) remains valid.
3472 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
3473 constexpr void remove(std::uint8_t child_index,
3474 db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
3475 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_index < this->children_count.load());
3476
3477 if constexpr (!ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3478 const auto r{ArtPolicy::reclaim_leaf_on_scope_exit(
3479 children[child_index].load().template ptr<leaf_type*>(),
3480 db_instance)};
3481 }
3482
3483 remove_child_entry(child_index);
3484 }
3485
3489 constexpr void remove_child_entry(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3490 auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3491 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_index < children_count_);
3492 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3493 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3494
3495 for (unsigned i = child_index + 1U; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3496 keys.byte_array[i - 1] = keys.byte_array[i];
3497 children[i - 1] = children[i];
3498 }
3499
3500 --children_count_;
3501 this->children_count = children_count_;
3502
3503 // Shift bitmask bits to match shifted children array.
3504 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3505 bitmask_base::remove_at(child_index);
3506 }
3507
3508 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3509 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3510 }

3512 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()

3519 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr find_result find_child(
3520 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3521#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3522 const auto replicated_search_key =
3523 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(key_byte));
3524 const auto matching_key_positions =
3525 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(replicated_search_key, keys.byte_vector);
3526 const auto mask = (1U << this->children_count) - 1;
3527 const auto bit_field =
3528 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(matching_key_positions)) & mask;
3529 if (bit_field != 0) {
3530 const auto i = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::countr_zero(bit_field));
3531 return std::make_pair(
3532 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
3533 }
3534 return parent_class::child_not_found;
3535#elif defined(__aarch64__)
3536 const auto replicated_search_key =
3537 vdupq_n_u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
3538 const auto matching_key_positions =
3539 vceqq_u8(replicated_search_key, keys.byte_vector);
3540 const auto narrowed_positions =
3541 vshrn_n_u16(vreinterpretq_u16_u8(matching_key_positions), 4);
3542 const auto scalar_pos =
3543 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
3544 vget_lane_u64(vreinterpret_u64_u8(narrowed_positions), 0);
3545 const auto child_count = this->children_count.load();
3546 const auto mask = (child_count == 16) ? 0xFFFFFFFF'FFFFFFFFULL
3547 : (1ULL << (child_count << 2U)) - 1;
3548 const auto masked_pos = scalar_pos & mask;
3549
3550 if (masked_pos == 0) return parent_class::child_not_found;
3551
3552 const auto i = static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(masked_pos) >> 2U);
3553 return std::make_pair(
3554 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
3555#else
3556 for (size_t i = 0; i < this->children_count.load(); ++i)
3557 if (key_byte == keys.byte_array[i])
3558 return std::make_pair(
3559 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
3560 return parent_class::child_not_found;
3561#endif
3562 }
3563
3569 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr node_ptr get_child(
3570 std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3571 return children[child_index].load();

3577 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result
3578 begin() noexcept {
3579 const auto key = keys.byte_array[0].load();
3580 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, 0,
3581 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};
3582 }
3583
3587 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result
3588 last() noexcept {
3589 const auto child_index{
3590 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(this->children_count.load() - 1)};
3591 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
3592 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, child_index,
3593 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};

3595
3601 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3602 next(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3603 const auto nchildren{this->children_count.load()};
3604 const auto next_index{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_index + 1)};
3605 if (next_index >= nchildren) return parent_class::end_result;
3606 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
3607 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, next_index,
3608 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3609 }
3610
3616 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3617 prior(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3618 if (child_index == 0) return parent_class::end_result;
3619 const auto next_index{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_index - 1)};
3620 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
3621 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, next_index,
3622 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3623 }
3624
3630 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3631 lte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3632 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3633 for (std::int64_t i = children_count_ - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
3634 const auto child_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
3635 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
3636 if (key <= key_byte) {
3637 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, child_index,
3638 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3639 }
3640 }
3641 // The first key in the node is GT the given key_byte.
3642 return parent_class::end_result;
3643 }
3644
3650 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3651 gte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3652 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3653 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3654 const auto key = keys.byte_array[i].load();
3655 if (key >= key_byte) {
3656 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, i,
3657 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3658 }
3659 }
3660 // This should only occur if there is no entry in the keys[] which
3661 // is greater-than the given [key_byte].
3662 return parent_class::end_result;
3663 }

3668 constexpr void delete_subtree(db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
3669 const uint8_t children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3670 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3671 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3672 if (is_value_in_slot(i)) continue;
3673 }
3674 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(children[i], db_instance);
3675 }

3682 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE void dump(std::ostream& os,
3683 bool recursive) const {
3684 parent_class::dump(os, recursive);
3685 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3686 os << ", key bytes =";
3687 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i)
3688 dump_byte(os, keys.byte_array[i]);
3689 if (recursive) {
3690 os << ", children: \n";
3691 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3692 if (is_value_in_slot(i)) {
3693 os << " [" << static_cast<unsigned>(i) << "] value=";
3694 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3695 os << ArtPolicy::unpack_value(children[i].load());
3696 }
3697 os << "\n";
3698 } else {
3699 ArtPolicy::dump_node(os, children[i].load());
3700 }
3701 }
3702 }

3705 private:
3711 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr auto get_sorted_key_array_insert_position(
3712 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3713 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3714
3715 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < basic_inode_16::capacity);
3716 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3717 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3718 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3719 std::adjacent_find(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3720 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_) >=
3721 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_);
3722
3723#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3724 const auto replicated_insert_key =
3725 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(key_byte));
3726 const auto lesser_key_positions =
3727 _mm_cmple_epu8(replicated_insert_key, keys.byte_vector);
3728 const auto mask = (1U << children_count_) - 1;
3729 const auto bit_field =
3730 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(lesser_key_positions)) & mask;
3731 const auto result =
3732 (bit_field != 0)
3733 ? static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::countr_zero(bit_field))
3734 : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_count_);
3735#else
3736 // This is also the best current ARM implementation
3737 const auto result = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(
3738 std::lower_bound(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3739 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_, key_byte) -
3740 keys.byte_array.cbegin());
3741#endif
3742
3743 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3744 result == children_count_ ||
3745 (result < children_count_ && keys.byte_array[result] != key_byte));
3746 return result;
3747 }
3748
3749 protected:
3751 union key_union {
3753 std::array<critical_section_policy<std::byte>, basic_inode_16::capacity>
3754 byte_array;
3755#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3757 __m128i byte_vector;
3758#elif defined(__aarch64__)
3760 uint8x16_t byte_vector;
3761#endif
3763 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26495)
3764 key_union() noexcept {}
3765 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
3766 };
3767
3768 public:
3769 [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool is_value_in_slot(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
3770 return bitmask_base::test(i);
3771 }
3772 constexpr void set_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3773 bitmask_base::set(i);
3774 }
3775 constexpr void clear_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3776 bitmask_base::clear(i);
3777 }
3778
3780 key_union keys;
3781
3783 std::array<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>, basic_inode_16::capacity>
3784 children;
3785
3786 private:
3788 static constexpr std::uint8_t empty_child = 0xFF;
3789

3802 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
3803 db_type& db_instance, detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len,

3810 inode16_type::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,

3817 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3818 node->bitmask_base::bits = value_mask;
3819 }
3820 return result;

3948 constexpr void init_grow(db_type& db_instance,
3949 inode16_type& __restrict source_node,
3950 node_ptr child_val, std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3951 const auto reclaim_source_node{
3952 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode16_type>(
3953 &source_node, db_instance)};
3954
3955 std::uint8_t i = 0;
3956 for (; i < inode16_type::capacity; ++i) {
3957 const auto existing_key_byte = source_node.keys.byte_array[i].load();
3958 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(existing_key_byte)] = i;
3959 }
3960 for (i = 0; i < inode16_type::capacity; ++i) {
3961 children.pointer_array[i] = source_node.children[i];
3962 }
3963
3964 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
3965 empty_child);
3966 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(i == inode16_type::capacity);
3967
3968 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] = i;
3969 children.pointer_array[i] = child_val;
3970 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3971 // Copy bitmask from source I16 (indexed by position).
3972 for (std::uint8_t j = 0; j < inode16_type::capacity; ++j) {
3973 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(j)) set_value_bit_by_ci(j);
3974 }
3975 // The new child is a packed value.
3976 set_value_bit_by_ci(i);
3977 }
3978 for (i = this->children_count; i < basic_inode_48::capacity; i++) {
3979 children.pointer_array[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
3980 }
3981 }
3982
3988 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26460)
3989 // MSVC C26815 false positive: reclaim objects intentionally destroyed at
3990 // scope exit while db_instance (passed by caller) remains valid.
3991 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
3992 constexpr void init(db_type& db_instance,
3993 inode256_type& __restrict source_node,
3994 std::uint8_t child_to_delete) noexcept {
3995 const auto reclaim_source_node{
3996 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode256_type>(
3997 &source_node, db_instance)};
3998 [[maybe_unused]] const auto r{ArtPolicy::reclaim_if_leaf(
3999 source_node.children[child_to_delete].load(), db_instance)};
4000
4001 source_node.children[child_to_delete] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4002 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4003 source_node.clear_value_bit(child_to_delete);
4004 }
4005
4006 std::uint8_t next_child = 0;
4007 for (unsigned child_i = 0; child_i < 256; child_i++) {
4008 const auto child_ptr = source_node.children[child_i].load();
4009 if (child_ptr == nullptr &&
4010 !(ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf &&
4011 source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_i))))
4012 continue;
4013
4014 child_indexes[child_i] = next_child;
4015 children.pointer_array[next_child] = source_node.children[child_i].load();
4016 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4017 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_i)))
4018 set_value_bit_by_ci(next_child);
4019 }
4020 ++next_child;
4021
4022 if (next_child == basic_inode_48::capacity) return;
4023 }
4024 }

4036 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(db_leaf_unique_ptr&& child,
4037 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
4038 std::byte key_byte,
4039 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
4040 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == children_count_);
4041 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ >= parent_class::min_size);
4042 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
4043
4044 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4045 empty_child);
4046 unsigned i{0};
4047#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_SSE4_2
4048 const auto nullptr_vector = _mm_setzero_si128();
4049 while (true) {
4050 const auto ptr_vec0 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i]);
4051 const auto ptr_vec1 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i + 1]);
4052 const auto ptr_vec2 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i + 2]);
4053 const auto ptr_vec3 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i + 3]);
4054 const auto vec0_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec0, nullptr_vector);
4055 const auto vec1_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec1, nullptr_vector);
4056 const auto vec2_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec2, nullptr_vector);
4057 const auto vec3_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec3, nullptr_vector);
4058 // OK to treat 64-bit comparison result as 32-bit vector: we need to find
4059 // the first 0xFF only.
4060 const auto vec01_cmp = _mm_packs_epi32(vec0_cmp, vec1_cmp);
4061 const auto vec23_cmp = _mm_packs_epi32(vec2_cmp, vec3_cmp);
4062 const auto vec_cmp = _mm_packs_epi32(vec01_cmp, vec23_cmp);
4063 const auto cmp_mask =
4064 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(_mm_movemask_epi8(vec_cmp));
4065 if (cmp_mask != 0) {
4066 i = (i << 1U) +
4067 ((static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(cmp_mask)) + 1U) >> 1U);
4068 break;
4069 }
4070 i += 4;
4071 }
4072#elif defined(UNODB_DETAIL_AVX2)
4073 const auto nullptr_vector = _mm256_setzero_si256();
4074 while (true) {
4075 const auto ptr_vec0 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i]);
4076 const auto ptr_vec1 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i + 1]);
4077 const auto ptr_vec2 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i + 2]);
4078 const auto ptr_vec3 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i + 3]);
4079 const auto vec0_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec0, nullptr_vector);
4080 const auto vec1_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec1, nullptr_vector);
4081 const auto vec2_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec2, nullptr_vector);
4082 const auto vec3_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec3, nullptr_vector);
4083 const auto interleaved_vec01_cmp = _mm256_packs_epi32(vec0_cmp, vec1_cmp);
4084 const auto interleaved_vec23_cmp = _mm256_packs_epi32(vec2_cmp, vec3_cmp);
4085 const auto doubly_interleaved_vec_cmp =
4086 _mm256_packs_epi32(interleaved_vec01_cmp, interleaved_vec23_cmp);
4087 if (!_mm256_testz_si256(doubly_interleaved_vec_cmp,
4088 doubly_interleaved_vec_cmp)) {
4089 const auto vec01_cmp =
4090 _mm256_permute4x64_epi64(interleaved_vec01_cmp, 0b11'01'10'00);
4091 const auto vec23_cmp =
4092 _mm256_permute4x64_epi64(interleaved_vec23_cmp, 0b11'01'10'00);
4093 const auto interleaved_vec_cmp =
4094 _mm256_packs_epi32(vec01_cmp, vec23_cmp);
4095 const auto vec_cmp =
4096 _mm256_permute4x64_epi64(interleaved_vec_cmp, 0b11'01'10'00);
4097 const auto cmp_mask =
4098 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(_mm256_movemask_epi8(vec_cmp));
4099 i = (i << 2U) +
4100 (static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(cmp_mask)) >> 1U);
4101 break;
4102 }
4103 i += 4;
4104 }
4105#elif defined(__aarch64__)
4106 const auto nullptr_vector = vdupq_n_u64(0);
4107 while (true) {
4108 const auto ptr_vec0 = children.pointer_vector[i];
4109 const auto ptr_vec1 = children.pointer_vector[i + 1];
4110 const auto ptr_vec2 = children.pointer_vector[i + 2];
4111 const auto ptr_vec3 = children.pointer_vector[i + 3];
4112 const auto vec0_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec0);
4113 const auto vec1_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec1);
4114 const auto vec2_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec2);
4115 const auto vec3_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec3);
4116 const auto narrowed_cmp0 = vshrn_n_u64(vec0_cmp, 4);
4117 const auto narrowed_cmp1 = vshrn_n_u64(vec1_cmp, 4);
4118 const auto narrowed_cmp2 = vshrn_n_u64(vec2_cmp, 4);
4119 const auto narrowed_cmp3 = vshrn_n_u64(vec3_cmp, 4);
4120 const auto cmp01 = vcombine_u32(narrowed_cmp0, narrowed_cmp1);
4121 const auto cmp23 = vcombine_u32(narrowed_cmp2, narrowed_cmp3);
4122 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4123 const auto narrowed_cmp01 = vshrn_n_u32(cmp01, 4);
4124 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4125 const auto narrowed_cmp23 = vshrn_n_u32(cmp23, 4);
4126 const auto cmp = vcombine_u16(narrowed_cmp01, narrowed_cmp23);
4127 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4128 const auto narrowed_cmp = vshrn_n_u16(cmp, 4);
4129 const auto scalar_pos =
4130 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4131 vget_lane_u64(vreinterpret_u64_u8(narrowed_cmp), 0);
4132 if (scalar_pos != 0) {
4133 i = (i << 1U) +
4134 static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(scalar_pos) >> 3U);
4135 break;
4136 }
4137 i += 4;
4138 }
4139#else // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
4140 node_ptr child_ptr;
4141 while (true) {
4142 child_ptr = children.pointer_array[i];
4143 if (child_ptr == nullptr) break;
4144 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < 255);
4145 ++i;
4146 }
4147#endif // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
4148
4149 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(i < parent_class::capacity);
4150
4151#ifndef NDEBUG
4152 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children.pointer_array[i] == nullptr);
4153 for (unsigned j = 0; j < i; ++j)
4154 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children.pointer_array[j] != nullptr);
4155#endif
4156
4157 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] =
4158 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4159 children.pointer_array[i] = node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF};
4160 this->children_count = children_count_ + 1U;
4161 }

4164 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(node_ptr packed_value,
4165 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
4166 std::byte key_byte,
4167 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
4168 // Reuse the leaf overload by wrapping the packed value in a
4169 // temporary unique_ptr that immediately releases. This avoids
4170 // duplicating the SIMD slot-finding logic.
4171 // TODO(#707): refactor to share slot-finding code without this hack.
4172 std::ignore = children_count_;
4173 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4174 empty_child);
4175 // Find first empty slot (not occupied by pointer or VIS value).
4176 unsigned slot = 0;
4177 while (children.pointer_array[slot] != nullptr ||
4178 is_value_in_slot_by_ci(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(slot))) {
4179 ++slot;
4180 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(slot < parent_class::capacity);
4181 }
4182 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(slot < 48);
4183 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] =
4184 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(slot);
4185 children.pointer_array[slot] = packed_value;
4186 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
4187 this->children_count = this->children_count + 1U;
4188 }

4217 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_48::find_result
4218 find_child(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
4219 const auto child_i =
4220 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)].load();
4221 if (child_i != empty_child) {
4222 return std::make_pair(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte),
4223 &children.pointer_array[child_i]);
4224 }
4225 return parent_class::child_not_found;
4226 }

4236 // N48: This is the case where we need to indirect through child_indices.
4237 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr node_ptr get_child(
4238 std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
4239 const auto child_i = child_indexes[child_index].load();
4240 // In a data race, the child_indices[] can be concurrently
4241 // modified, which will cause the OLC version tag to get
4242 // bumped. However, we are in the middle of reading and acting on
4243 // the data while that happens. This can cause the value stored
4244 // in child_indices[] at our desired child_index to be empty_child
4245 // (0xFF). In this circumstance, the caller will correctly detect
4246 // a problem when they do read_critical_section::check(), but we
4247 // will have still indirected beyond the end of the allocation and
4248 // ASAN can fail us. To prevent that and read only the data that
4249 // is legally allocated to the node, we return nullptr in this
4250 // case and rely on the caller to detect a problem when they call
4251 // read_critical_section::check().
4252 return UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(child_i == empty_child)
4253 ? node_ptr() // aka nullptr
4254 : children.pointer_array[child_i].load();
4255 }

4264 for (std::uint64_t i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
4265 // cppcheck-suppress useStlAlgorithm

4376 constexpr void delete_subtree(db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
4377#ifndef NDEBUG
4378 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
4379 unsigned actual_children_count = 0;
4380#endif
4381
4382 for (unsigned i = 0; i < this->capacity; ++i) {
4383 const auto child = children.pointer_array[i].load();
4384 if (child != nullptr ||
4385 (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf &&
4386 is_value_in_slot_by_ci(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i)))) {
4387 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4388 if (!is_value_in_slot_by_ci(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i))) {

4394#ifndef NDEBUG

4397#endif

4407 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE void dump(std::ostream& os,
4408 bool recursive) const {

4410#ifndef NDEBUG
4411 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
4412 unsigned actual_children_count = 0;
4413#endif
4414
4415 os << ", key bytes & child indexes\n";
4416 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 256; i++)
4417 if (child_indexes[i] != empty_child) {

4421 << ": ";
4422 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children.pointer_array[child_indexes[i]] !=
4423 nullptr ||
4424 is_value_in_slot_by_ci(child_indexes[i]));
4425 if (recursive) {

4427 if (is_value_in_slot_by_ci(ci)) {

4429 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4430 os << ArtPolicy::unpack_value(children.pointer_array[ci].load());
4431 }
4432 os << "\n";
4433 } else {
4434 ArtPolicy::dump_node(os, children.pointer_array[ci].load());
4435 }
4436 }
4437#ifndef NDEBUG
4438 ++actual_children_count;
4439 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(actual_children_count <= children_count_);
4440#endif
4441 }
4442
4443 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(actual_children_count == children_count_);

4614 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_CLANG_21_WARNING("-Wnrvo")
4615 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
4616 db_type& db_instance, detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len,
4617 unodb::key_view prefix_key, tree_depth_type depth,
4618 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
4619 const std::array<std::uint8_t, 6>& value_mask = {}) {
4620 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
4621 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 17 && n <= 48);
4622 auto result =
4623 inode48_type::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
4624 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
4625 auto* node = result.get();
4626 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
4627 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_span[i].key_byte);
4628 node->child_indexes[kb] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4629 node->children.pointer_array[i] = children_span[i].child;
4630 }
4631 for (unsigned i = n; i < 48; ++i) {
4632 node->children.pointer_array[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4633 }
4634 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4635 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < value_mask.size(); ++i) {
4636 node->bitmask_base::bits[i] = value_mask[i];
4637 }
4638 }
4639 return result;
4640 }
4641 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_CLANG_21_WARNINGS()

4749 constexpr void init_grow(db_type& db_instance,
4750 inode48_type& __restrict source_node,
4751 node_ptr child_val, std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
4752 const auto reclaim_source_node{
4753 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode48_type>(
4754 &source_node, db_instance)};
4755 unsigned children_copied = 0;
4756 unsigned i = 0;
4757 while (true) {
4758 const auto children_i = source_node.child_indexes[i].load();
4759 if (children_i == inode48_type::empty_child) {
4760 children[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4761 } else {
4762 children[i] = source_node.children.pointer_array[children_i].load();
4763 ++children_copied;
4764 if (children_copied == inode48_type::capacity) break;
4765 }
4766 ++i;
4767 }
4768
4769 ++i;
4770 for (; i < basic_inode_256::capacity; ++i) children[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4771
4772 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4773 nullptr);
4774 children[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] = child_val;
4775 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4776 // Copy bitmask from source I48. I48 indexes by slot position,
4777 // I256 indexes by key byte. Map through child_indexes.
4778 for (unsigned j = 0; j < 256; ++j) {
4779 const auto ci = source_node.child_indexes[j].load();
4780 if (ci != inode48_type::empty_child &&
4781 source_node.is_value_in_slot_by_ci(ci)) {
4782 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j));
4783 }
4784 }
4785 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
4786 }
4787 }

4801 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == children_count_);
4802 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
4803
4804 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4805 nullptr);

4807 node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF};
4808 this->children_count = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_count_ + 1U);
4809 }

5010 template <typename Function>
5011 constexpr void for_each_child(Function func) const
5012 noexcept(noexcept(func(0, node_ptr{nullptr}))) {
5013#ifndef NDEBUG
5014 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
5015 std::uint8_t actual_children_count = 0;
5016#endif
5017
5018 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
5019 const auto child_ptr = children[i].load();
5020 if (child_ptr != nullptr ||
5021 (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf &&
5022 this->is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i)))) {
5023 func(i, child_ptr);
5024#ifndef NDEBUG
5025 ++actual_children_count;
5026 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(actual_children_count <= children_count_ ||
5027 children_count_ == 0);
5028#endif
5029 }
5030 }
5031 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(actual_children_count == children_count_);
5032 }
5033
5037 constexpr void delete_subtree(db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
5038 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
5039 for_each_child([this, &db_instance](unsigned i, node_ptr child) noexcept {
5040 if (this->is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i))) return;
5041 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(child, db_instance);
5042 });
5043 } else {
5044 for_each_child(
5045 [&db_instance]([[maybe_unused]] unsigned i, node_ptr child) noexcept {
5046 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(child, db_instance);
5047 });
5048 }
5049 }
5050
5055 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE void dump(std::ostream& os,
5056 bool recursive) const {
5057 parent_class::dump(os, recursive);
5058 os << ", key bytes & children:\n";
5059 for_each_child([&os, recursive, this](unsigned i, node_ptr child) {
5060 os << ' ';
5061 dump_byte(os, static_cast<std::byte>(i));
5062 os << ' ';
5063 if (recursive) {
5064 if (is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i))) {
5065 os << "value=";
5066 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
5067 os << ArtPolicy::unpack_value(child);
5068 }
5069 os << "\n";
5070 } else {
5071 ArtPolicy::dump_node(os, child);
5072 }
5073 }
5074 });
5075 }

5077 public:
5078 [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool is_value_in_slot(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
5079 return bitmask_base::test(i);
5080 }
5081 constexpr void set_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
5082 bitmask_base::set(i);
5083 }
5084 constexpr void clear_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
5085 bitmask_base::clear(i);
5086 }
5087
5089 std::array<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>, basic_inode_256::capacity>
5090 children;

5093 friend class basic_inode_48;
5094 friend class basic_inode_impl<ArtPolicy>;

5096 public:
5101 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_CLANG_21_WARNING("-Wnrvo")
5102 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
5103 db_type& db_instance, detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len,
5104 unodb::key_view prefix_key, tree_depth_type depth,
5105 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
5106 const std::array<std::uint8_t, 32>& value_mask = {}) {
5107 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
5108 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 49 && n <= 256);
5109 auto result =
5110 parent_class::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
5111 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
5112 auto* node = result.get();
5113 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
5114 node->children[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
5115 }
5116 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
5117 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_span[i].key_byte);
5118 node->children[kb] = children_span[i].child;
5119 }
5120 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
5121 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < value_mask.size(); ++i) {
5122 node->bitmask_base::bits[i] = value_mask[i];
5123 }
5124 }
5125 return result;
5126 }
5127 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_CLANG_21_WARNINGS()

5130// ─── Bulk Load: build_chain ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
5131
5132UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
5133UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(4459)
5134
5135template <class ArtPolicy>
5136[[nodiscard]] typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr bulk_build_chain(
5137 typename ArtPolicy::db_type& self, typename ArtPolicy::art_key_type k,
5138 typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr child,
5139 tree_depth<typename ArtPolicy::art_key_type> start_depth) {
5140 using node_ptr = typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr;
5141 using inode_4 = typename ArtPolicy::inode4_type;
5142 using tree_depth_type = tree_depth<typename ArtPolicy::art_key_type>;
5143 constexpr std::size_t cap = key_prefix_capacity;
5144 const auto full_key = k.get_key_view();
5145 const auto key_len = k.size();
5146 const auto start = static_cast<std::size_t>(start_depth);
5147 auto current = child;
5148 bool child_is_value = ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf;
5149 bool owns_current = false;
5150 try {
5151 std::size_t pos = key_len;
5152 while (pos > start + cap) {
5153 const auto depth = pos - cap - 1;
5154 const auto dispatch = full_key[pos - 1];
5155 auto remaining = k;
5156 remaining.shift_right(depth);
5157 auto chain{
5158 inode_4::create(self, full_key, remaining,
5159 tree_depth_type{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(depth)},
5160 dispatch, current)};
5161 if (child_is_value) {
5162 chain->set_value_bit(0);
5163 child_is_value = false;
5164 }
5165 current = node_ptr{chain.release(), node_type::I4};
5166 owns_current = true;
5167#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
5168 self.template account_growing_inode<node_type::I4>();
5169#endif
5170 pos = depth;
5171 }
5172 if (pos > start) {
5173 const auto dispatch = full_key[pos - 1];
5174 auto chain{inode_4::create(
5175 self, full_key, tree_depth_type{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(start)},
5176 static_cast<key_prefix_size>(pos - start - 1), dispatch, current)};
5177 if (child_is_value) {
5178 chain->set_value_bit(0);
5179 }
5180 current = node_ptr{chain.release(), node_type::I4};
5181#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
5182 self.template account_growing_inode<node_type::I4>();
5183#endif
5184 }
5185 return current;
5186 } catch (...) {
5187 if (owns_current) {
5188 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(current, self);
5189 } else if (!child_is_value) {
5190 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(current, self);
5191 }
5192 throw;
5193 }
5194}
